limitations: DoWhy causal estimator is functional in this environment (3.12.0). However, no real-data causal estimates were produced because real experiment runs lack per-window drift labels and have too few observations (preflight gate G1 failed).

Total telemetry collection dropout in raw/ (2026-08-23): All 6 indexed runs in raw/ contain zero detections due to collector API client port-forward disconnection; lack of detections represents a telemetry collection dropout, NOT evidence of negative drift or true negative detector silence.
Zero benign controls in raw3 (N_benign = 0): False Positive Rate (FPR), Precision, and F1 score are mathematically undefined without negative-class controls and cannot be fabricated as zero.

Upstream identity resolution failure: 100% of recorded drift detections in raw3 (3,701/3,701) have pod_name='unknown', container_name='unknown', null sbom_id, null purl, and dummy sha256:000... image digests. Component-level causal attribution cannot be empirically established from raw telemetry.

Unmeasured Prometheus overhead: Resource metrics (cpu_usage_cores, memory_rss_mb, event_lag_p95_ms) all defaulted to 0.0 due to unhandled collection errors on query failure. True monitoring overhead is unmeasured, not zero.

Failed injection exclusions: 3 out of 9 runs in raw3 (all 3 repetitions of solarwinds-001) failed injection rollout (inject_ok=False) and were excluded from detection sensitivity (TPR) denominators per protocol.

Preflight Gate G1 software sanity guard: Sample size N < 10 failed preflight sanity check; causal estimation cleanly abstained with 'insufficient_evidence: too_few_observations' without bypassing technical software gates.
Per-window runtime_sbom_drift outcome labels do not exist. CausalObservation rows cannot be built with valid outcome values from the current dataset.

Baseline telemetry absence: Falco alert logs are empty, Trivy static scans represent point-in-time image vulnerability scans unlinked to runtime drift windows, and IsolationForest runtime anomaly streams were uncollected. Baseline metrics are recorded as telemetry_unavailable / NR.
